chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad, from Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad, from Wuheyb ibn Hafs, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)
Regarding a man who passed away and left his wife, he said: 'For the woman is the one-quarter, and whatever remains, so it is for the Imam.'

key_terms.فَلِلْإِمَامِ: so it is for the Imam

ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of a wife when her husband dies leaving no other heirs?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi details the specific inheritance ruling for a man who dies leaving only his wife, assigning her one-quarter of the estate with the remainder going to the Imam (peace be upon him). In Shia jurisprudence, this scenario highlights the concept of 'Rijal' (male heir) absence, where the Imam acts as the sole heir to the residual estate, distinguishing it from the Sunni view where the wife might receive one-half in the absence of other heirs. The chain of narration through Abu Basir to Imam al-Sadiq underscores the reliability of this transmission within the Usuli school.

en.hubeali:
Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad, from Wuheyb Bin Hafs, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>
regarding a man who passed away and left his wife. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘For the woman is the one-quarter, and whatever remains, so it is for the Imam<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 3. Humayd ibn Ziyad has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Muhammad from Wuhayb ibn Hafs from abu Basir who has narrated the following: “About the case of a woman who dies and leaves behind her husband, abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
One-fourth belongs to the woman and the rest belongs to the Imam.’”
